**ReelPing** — Keep your viewers in the loop.
A lightweight, self-hosted **Plex Media Server status monitor and Discord notifier**, optimized for Unraid.
ReelPing watches your Plex server and posts **one** clear Discord alert when a confirmed outage happens, a recovery notice (with the outage duration) when it's back, and gives you one-click **planned-maintenance** announcements — schedule, start-now, "going offline", delay updates, and service-restored.
- Uses **Discord incoming webhooks** — no bot required. - Works with Plex hosted anywhere reachable over the network (Docker, VM, another NAS, another server, or a reverse proxy). - **No** privileged mode, Docker socket, host networking, or media/Plex access — it only reaches Plex over the network. - **No telemetry.** Authenticated web UI (Argon2id, CSRF, security headers); no default password.
For documentation, installation, issues, and support, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BGriffin63/ReelPing).
ReelPing is an independent community project and is **not** affiliated with or endorsed by Plex, Inc., Discord Inc., or Lime Technology, Inc.
